values: 一名敏捷的游侠，在战斗中擅长寻找最强的敌人进行单挑。
An agile Rogue who excels in duels against the most powerful enemy.
我只是在打盹儿，马上就精神了！
I was just catching some Zs, I'll be up in no time!
状态大好，我的兴致提起来了
我的利爪，可不是摆设哦！
These claws aren't just for show!
要睡个大觉，补充体力啊……
I guess it's time for a nap...
无所事事才是人生的最高境界呀
Lounging around is my ultimate life goal.
瞧好了，今天就让你……见识绝技！
Keep those eyes peeled, today I'll show you my skills!
哈，睡醒了，该活动筋骨咯！
Ha, I'm awake and ready to stretch these legs!
Left, right, and a stretch! Good morning!
嘿，看招！只是热身而已啦
Watch this! I'm just warming up.
舒舒服服醒来，开开心心收礼！
Waking up to a nice gift is lovely!
野性之美与森林的原始力量。
Untamed beauty mixed with the raw power of the wild.
让校园里充满阳光与野性！
Bring sunlight and passion back to campus!
Meow... Ah, time for a stretch!
Let me take a nap... for five hours!
今晚要暖呼呼地睡觉喵
I'm going to sleep all cozy and warm tonight!
It's purr-fectly cozy the moment you step in!
蕾米雅是接替莱卡成为新任薄暮巡游者队长的人，实际年龄却比莱卡要大。
Lenya has taken the helm as captain of the Dusk Patrollers, succeeding Lyca, even though she's actually older than her.
蕾米雅天赋很高，但过于懒散，以至于很多人不清楚她的真正实力。
Despite her remarkable talent, Lenya's lazy attitude keeps her true strength hidden from many.
蕾米雅不太喜欢绿裔的食物，她经常偷偷跑去圣石镇吃喝。这也是她此前反对封锁令的原因之一。
Lenya dislikes Wilder cuisine, so she would ignore the exclusion edict and sneak off to Holistone for meals and drinks.
蕾米雅对奶油制品和啤酒情有独钟，闻到这两者的味道便会从昏睡中苏醒过来。
On a dare, Lenya once climbed the tallest tree in the Dark Forest and held a conversation with a family of squirrels who mistook her for a giant, fluffy tree spirit.
敌人见到蕾米雅时常常会放松警惕，结果就是被一记回旋踢击中。
Lenya has a unique bond with fireflies, who always seem to gather around her in a twinkling halo when she hums softly to herself during campfire nights.
有传言称蕾米雅会在满月时分进行一种奇怪的仪式，以此来提升自己的体能。
Rumor has it that Lenya performs an odd ritual during full moons to enhance her physical prowess.
有目击者称蕾米雅会收集自己掉落的所有毛发，实际用途未知。
Witnesses claim that Lenya gathers all of her shed fur, though for what reason, nobody knows...
蕾米雅不会明面上表现出对别人的好感，但她的尾巴会不自觉地挽上她喜欢的人。
Lenya doesn't openly express affection, but her tail has a habit of curling around those she holds dear.
蕾米雅讨厌下雨，因为这会让她的毛毛湿哒哒的。所以她喜欢跟告雨一族做朋友。
Lenya despises rain because it leaves her fur damp and bedraggled, which is why she likes to befriend the Azure Seers.
蕾米雅对于事情有自己的理解，当她进行传达工作时，总会不自觉地添油加醋。
Despite her carefree demeanor, Lenya has a hidden talent for intricate origami, and she often surprises her friends with tiny paper sculptures during quiet moments on their journeys.
啊哈哈哈哈！毛线球！滚来滚去的毛线球！
Ahahaha! Yarn balls! Rolling, rolling yarn balls!
